context: Sho and Hina chat at end of day.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、今日も、本当、楽しかった。
lines.en: Sho — today was so much fun too.
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious opener. Quick warm energy, the kind only an eight-year-old can carry. Genuine delight threaded through each word, no performance. Slight lift on 'too' — the joy of repetition, of shared goodness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah — being together like this, it really makes me happy.
lines.style: Small, quiet affirmation. Six-year-old genuineness — no flourish, just the actual feeling in his voice. Soft and steady. The words feel like they cost him something to say, and he means every one.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Friends really are precious, aren't they.
lines.style: Hina processing something true out loud. Bright but slower now — like she's discovered this fact mid-sentence. Warm, certain, almost wondering. The kind of thing an eight-year-old says when she's genuinely moved and doesn't have a bigger word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Sho's voice drops even quieter. Not sadness — tenderness. The words sit with weight. He's six and saying something that matters to him, without decoration. Small breath before the second phrase.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Hina's closing, lingering and soft. Unselfconscious warmth, the brightness gently dimmed for the hour. She means the 'truly' — it lands like a small promise. Trailing-off into sleepiness but held with care.
